# OpenMotion OpenMotion is **the first full-stack agentic video generator**. Upload a reference video or paste a social video link to **recreate it with your own brand kit and copy**. - 🎬 **Full-stack video recreation.** Code video with HTML. Your agent breaks down the reference, rebuilds its shots and transitions, and generates missing assets. Edit the timing in Studio and render an MP4 from the same project. - 🔑 **BYOA — Bring Your Own Agent. BYOK — Bring Your Own Keys.** OpenMotion is free and open source. Recreate videos in [your local agent](#agent-wall) and use your own API keys at every layer. - 🧩 OpenMotion introduces **Motion.md**, a Markdown format for shot order, timing and transitions. Use it to share how a brand film works, shot by shot. - 🎛️ **Images, video, music and voice.** Generate artwork with Nano Banana 2, add a shot with Seedance 2.0, score it with Suno v4 and narrate it with Kokoro. [Explore all seven built-in models](#model-wall). ### Install in your agent Copy this instruction into your local agent to install OpenMotion: ```text Read https://releases.open-design.ai/open-motion/install.md and follow the instructions to install and connect OpenMotion in the current agent. ``` After installation, the agent offers a template to try. Confirm the choice before creating a project. [Installation and first-run guide](docs/install.md#installation-success-reply) **22 local agents** · [Choose your agent](#choose-agent)

## ✨ Why OpenMotion ### 1. The first full-stack agentic video generator **Code video with HTML.** OpenMotion uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript to describe scenes, typography, layout, transitions and timing. Recorded footage, generated clips, images, music and voice-over become media inside the composition. The same project opens in Studio and renders to MP4. ![Your local agent, optional media-model accounts and creative resources feed a workflow of understanding the reference, coding scenes, generating missing media, editing and rendering MP4 with reusable source.](docs/readme/diagrams/creation-stack.svg) **Write it. Watch it. Change it. Render it.** Ask your agent to replace the product, tighten the hook, add a presenter, change the captions or try another ending. It edits the project source; you review the result in the visual editor. Local MCP clients use the project tools, while agents with shell access can follow the Skills and pinned CLI workflow. [Agent setup](#agent-setup) · [Native composition guide](skills/openmotion-production/references/native.md) · [Example HTML project](template-library/product-promo/index.html) If historical media are unavailable, an Agent restore is refused before changing the project. The editor shows a dismissible error with the affected file paths and confirms that the current project is unchanged. Review your video, arrange clips and export from the same Studio workspace. #### What you can change in Studio | In the Studio | What you can do today | | --- | --- | | **Story and timeline** | Import and arrange media; have the agent trim, reorder and revise against a script or confirmed timecodes | | **Motion and captions** | Author animated type, transitions, callouts, charts and captions around your content | | **Media and sound** | Import your material and generate images, video, music and TTS voice-over through the built-in model integrations | | **Image revision** | Generate candidates with a reference-capable image model and adopt a replacement while preserving timing and animation | | **Preview and versions** | Review in Studio, edit by hand or with your agent, and return to the project for the next revision | | **Export and source** | Render a fixed version to MP4 and retain the HTML, CSS, JavaScript and media | > “Keep the reveal we approved. Replace the middle scene with this screen recording, tighten the opening using these timecodes, and hold our final CTA for two more seconds.” [Projects and versions](docs/project-workspace.md) #### From a reference clip to an editable remake 1. **Break down the reference.** Pick a sequence. Record its shot order, transitions and sound cues in Motion.md, and mark what you want to replace. 2. **Rebuild the shots.** Your agent rebuilds the HTML scenes using your brand kit, copy and visuals, then arranges them on an editable timeline in Studio. 3. **Compare the cuts.** Watch the same moment in the original and the remake. Adjust the timing, movement and sound, then play the sequence through. 4. **Export and share.** Render the MP4 and keep the HTML source and media. To share a project others can adapt, include its Motion.md, a preview and assets you can redistribute. [Project contribution checklist](library/ENTRY_TEMPLATE.md) ### 2. Free and open source. Use your local agent and bring your own keys. **Choose your agent.** WorkBuddy, Codex, Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness have installation instructions. Other buttons open the shared MCP and CLI setup.

| Bring your own… | Make it work for your video | | --- | --- | | **🤖 Agent — BYOA** | Connect your existing local agent through Skills and MCP, with CLI access where supported. Keep your preferred client, account and working context. | | **🔑 Keys — BYOK** | Connect supported media-provider API keys in Model Settings. Choose models for images, video, music and TTS; supported local media integrations can use your existing agent login. | | **🎨 Brand and material** | Add your logo, fonts, screenshots, camera footage, script and music. Keep identity and approved assets in the Brand Kit section of Motion.md. | | **🧩 Starting resources** | Browse references, motion components, templates and community Skills. Pick a direction, give the source or reference to your agent, and make it yours. | **The OpenMotion creation pipeline is open source: Skills, project tools, model integrations, Studio and rendering.** Run it locally, inspect the implementation and extend the parts you need. OpenMotion charges no software subscription or per-render fee for this local workflow. You can also work with your own footage, images and audio without invoking media-generation APIs. Provider credentials stay in your workspace, separate from the video project. Your agent and media providers bill any subscriptions or usage to your own accounts. [Agent setup and compatibility](docs/agent-adapters.md) ### 3. 100+ Motion.md guides for video recreation OpenMotion introduces **Motion.md**: a Markdown format for shot order, timing, transitions and the assets you can replace. The online library brings reference videos and their motion guides into the same detail page. The Brand Kit section records your logo, colors, fonts, voice and approved product facts. Keep the reference’s motion and pacing while making the result recognizably yours. ![Motion.md and brand context](docs/readme/diagrams/creative-context.svg) #### Find a template, then make it yours Browse by **reference brand, use case and video type**, or search for a specific idea. A template detail page brings together the preview, visual style, production notes and Motion.md download. Choose **Recreate template** in Studio to copy a prompt for your agent. Reference-only entries start a reconstruction workflow. When editable source is available, your agent can adapt the project directly. ![Find a template, then make it yours](docs/readme/live-product/catalog.en.jpg) [Browse the template library](https://open-design.ai/templates/) ### 4. Multimodal generation: images, video, music and speech **BYOK makes your multimodal accounts part of the video workflow.** Add your supported provider keys in **Model Settings**, choose your models, and generate images, video, music and speech through the Studio's **Model Gateway**. Preview candidates and adopt the results into the same project your agent and Studio edit. The supported local image path can reuse your existing agent login.

Add the selected results to the recreated project, align the sound and visuals, then show me the full cut.” [Model catalog](gateway/catalog.ts) · [Provider setup and endpoints](docs/model-gateway.md) ## 🛠️ Setup and technical documentation ### Install from source For agent-led installation, use the [installation instruction above](#quick-start). To run from source, follow the steps below. If MCP tools are missing or fail to connect, use the installed [connection diagnosis and recovery guide](docs/npm-installation.md#missing-mcp-tools-or-a-failed-connection) to inspect the actual host configuration and verify the original workspace before continuing. Use Git, npm and **Node.js 26.11.1**. Source-based preview and export also need Chrome/Chromium and FFmpeg/FFprobe. [Runtime setup](docs/usage.md) ```sh git clone https://github.com/nexu-io/openmotion.git cd openmotion npm ci npm run build:studio npm start ``` Open the `studioUrl` or `previewUrl` printed by `npm start`, then open **Template library**. Startup reuses a compatible service for the same workspace or selects an available local port. The service keeps running in the background after the launcher exits. Select a template and choose **Recreate template** to copy the instruction for your agent. Keep projects and credentials outside the checkout; `MOTION_DATA_DIR` selects the workspace. Source checkouts load templates from `library/templates/catalog/`. The local Studio and MCP use the same files; `openmotion_list_templates` returns a searchable local index, and `openmotion_get_template` returns local guide content and absolute source paths. Imported large images and videos retain existing CMS links; new contribution media can use Git LFS. Local edits appear on the next catalog read. The plugin root is this checkout: `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` loads its `skills/` and `.mcp.json`, which launches the root `mcp.ts`. Start stdio with `npm run mcp` or use an absolute path in [manual MCP configuration](#manual-mcp). [Local template workflow](docs/template-repository.md#run-from-a-local-clone). #### Bring it into your agent For Codex with plugin support, run from the checkout: ```sh bash scripts/install-motion.command ``` **WorkBuddy** · Import the OpenMotion connector in WorkBuddy or add its `mcp.json` as a custom MCP server. Ask WorkBuddy to list the available video templates. [WorkBuddy setup](docs/agent-adapters.md#workbuddy) **Claude Code** · Select `--host claude` in the local installer, then run `/mcp` in Claude Code to check the connection. [Local installation guide](docs/npm-installation.md) **DeepSeek** · Work with the editable HTML project from the terminal in DeepSeek TUI. For DeepSeek Harness, connect the OpenMotion MCP tools with the Cordis configuration. [DeepSeek Harness setup](docs/agent-adapters.md#deepseek-harness) The installer uses locally built packages. [Windows test packages](docs/test-packages.md) Try an online template: > Use OpenMotion to recreate the template at this detail-page URL with my brand kit and copy. Keep the motion and pacing, then open the editable result in Studio for review. To start from a video instead, supply your reference and use the [recreation brief](#reverse-engineer-a-video). If your host cannot open Studio beside the conversation, use the returned local project link. ##### Skills, MCP and CLI The plugin and MCP server are named `openmotion`; Tools, Skills and resources use `openmotion_*`, `openmotion-*` and `openmotion://`. Existing names remain explicit compatibility aliases. See [naming and installation compatibility](docs/npm-installation.md#public-names-and-compatibility). From the checkout, discover and install the five core workflows with the [Skills CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills): ```sh npx skills add ./skills --list npx skills add ./skills --skill openmotion-director openmotion-production openmotion-template-to-video openmotion-recreate openmotion-video-to-template ``` This copies instructions; it does not install the runtime or register MCP. Keep the shared documentation available and connect the app separately, or use the integrated local installer above. | Skill | Use it for | | --- | --- | | [openmotion-recreate](skills/openmotion-recreate/SKILL.md) | Reconstructing a reference video and comparing the result | | [openmotion-template-to-video](skills/openmotion-template-to-video/SKILL.md) | Adapting an existing editable template | | [openmotion-director](skills/openmotion-director/SKILL.md) | Original films, narrative, movement, sound and creative review | | [openmotion-video-to-template](skills/openmotion-video-to-template/SKILL.md) | Producing a portable reusable template | | [openmotion-production](skills/openmotion-production/SKILL.md) | Scoped edits, preview, checks, troubleshooting and export | **Connect a local agent** · Follow the installation guide for your client. Use the configuration below in clients with local stdio MCP support. In a shell-based agent, open the project directory and use the [local engine CLI](skills/openmotion-production/references/native.md) to preview and render the HTML scenes. ```json { "mcpServers": { "openmotion": { "command": "/absolute/path/to/node", "args": ["--experimental-strip-types", "/absolute/openmotion/mcp.ts"], "env": { "MOTION_DATA_DIR": "/absolute/openmotion-data" } } } } ``` The **eleven public MCP tools** cover template discovery and details, project creation and reading, editing, preview, media import, export, version restoration and cancellation. Shared workflow and engine guides are available through MCP resources. [Tool contract](docs/mcp-phase1-tools.md) Find a template with `openmotion_list_templates`, inspect it with `openmotion_get_template`, then create an editable copy with `openmotion_create_project`. [Template catalog](docs/template-catalog.md) Use `npm start` for the app and `npm run mcp` for stdio. [Native authoring](skills/openmotion-production/references/native.md) ### From a reference to an editable project | Study the reference | Rebuild for your story | | --- | --- | | **Hook and narrative** — what appears first, what follows, what earns the reveal | Your promise, product facts and call to action | | **Shot structure** — framing, camera movement, layers and visual hierarchy | Your UI, footage, logo and supporting images | | **Motion and pacing** — entrances, transitions, easing and reading holds | The same motion intent, adjusted to your content | | **Typography and identity** — type hierarchy, color and composition | Your fonts, palette and words, recorded in Motion.md’s Brand Kit section | | **Sound and rhythm** — speech timing, music cues and emphasis | Your voice, supplied music and sound direction | Supply the clip and timecodes if your agent cannot open the social link. Start from the reference with the [recreation workflow](skills/openmotion-recreate/SKILL.md), or use the [template workflow](skills/openmotion-template-to-video/SKILL.md) when you already have editable source. ```text Use OpenMotion to reverse-engineer the attached reference for our brand. Study: the opening hook, shot order, typography, transitions and sound cues. Keep: the product reveal and camera rhythm in the selected segment. Replace: the logo, UI, claims, copy and end card with our supplied materials. Generate: missing images, video, background music and TTS narration using our configured models, following our brand and approved script. Build an editable project. Open it in Studio and compare matching moments with the reference. Explain any remaining differences. After review, export an MP4 and retain the source for the next edit. ``` #### Review the template and its Motion.md Open a template to watch the reference and read its visual style and production notes. Download Motion.md when you want the guide as a reusable file. ![Review the template and its Motion.md](docs/readme/live-product/detail.en.jpg) #### Send the template to your agent Choose **Recreate template**, copy the instruction and add your brand kit, copy and creative requirements. Your agent installs or connects OpenMotion if needed, then works from the selected template. Open the resulting project in Studio to review the timing, continue editing and export. ![Send the template to your agent](docs/readme/live-product/remix.en.jpg) ### System architecture Editing the timeline in Studio and asking your agent to change a shot both update the same HTML project. The local TypeScript service manages media and revisions. A browser-based rendering engine exports the selected version to MP4. #### How the modules work together ![The local agent connects through nine MCP project tools and Studio through local HTTP. The application manages revisions, assets and export jobs; the Model Gateway supplies media to the editable project, and the renderer exports and checks the selected project version.](docs/readme/diagrams/runtime-architecture-painterly.png) Edits made through the project tools include a revision check so an outdated request cannot overwrite newer work. Generated media enters the project when you select it. Each export uses the version saved when the job starts. The exporter checks the file specifications, and you can play the cut to review the picture, sound and timing.

## ✨ 为什么选择 OpenMotion ### 1. 首个全栈 Agentic 视频生成器 **用 HTML 写视频。** OpenMotion 用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 描述场景、字体、布局、转场和时间。实拍、生成片段、图片、音乐和旁白作为合成素材，同一工程可在 Studio 打开并渲染为 MP4。 ![本地 Agent、可选媒体模型账号和创作资源共同支持参考理解、场景编码、素材生成、剪辑及 MP4 渲染，并保留可复用源码。](docs/readme/diagrams/creation-stack.zh-CN.svg) **编写、观看、修改、渲染。** 让 Agent 替换产品、精简开头、加入真人、修改字幕或尝试新结尾。它修改工程源码，你在可视化编辑器中审阅。本地 MCP 客户端使用工程工具，具备 shell 的 Agent 还可遵循 Skills 和固定版本 CLI 工作流。[Agent 配置](#agent-setup) · [原生合成指南](skills/openmotion-production/references/native.md) · [HTML 示例工程](template-library/product-promo/index.html) 在同一个 Studio 工作区中预览视频、排列片段并导出成片。 #### 在 Studio 里可以改什么 | Studio 中 | 当前可以做什么 | | --- | --- | | **故事与时间轴** | 导入、排列素材，让 Agent 按脚本或确认的时间码精简、重排和改稿 | | **动效与字幕** | 围绕内容编写动态文字、转场、标注、图表和字幕 | | **素材与声音** | 导入素材，通过内置模型集成生成图片、视频、音乐和 TTS 旁白 | | **图片修改** | 用支持参考图的模型生成候选，采用替换时保留时间和动画 | | **预览与版本** | 在 Studio 审阅，手动或让 Agent 修改，保留工程供后续迭代 | | **导出与源码** | 将固定版本渲染为 MP4，保留 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 和素材 | > “保留已确认的揭示效果。中间场景换成这段屏幕录制，按这些时间码精简开头，最后的 CTA 多停留两秒。” [工程与版本](docs/project-workspace.md) #### 从参考片到可编辑的复刻工程 1. **拆解参考片。** 选一段想复刻的镜头，用 Motion.md 记下镜头顺序、转场和声音落点，标出要换成自己品牌的部分。 2. **重建镜头。** Agent 按你的品牌视觉规范，结合文案和产品画面重建 HTML 场景，在 Studio 里排成一条可编辑的时间轴。 3. **对照审片。** 在同一时间点比较原片与复刻结果，微调镜头时长、动作和声音，再播放整段确认节奏。 4. **导出和分享。** 渲染 MP4，保留 HTML 源码和素材。要让其他人改编，可以把 Motion.md、预览和可分享的素材随工程一起提交。[工程提交清单](library/ENTRY_TEMPLATE.md) ### 2. 完全开源免费，在本地 Agent 直接用，每一层都支持 BYOK **选择你的 Agent。** WorkBuddy、Codex、Claude Code 和 DeepSeek Harness 可直接查看安装步骤。其他按钮打开通用的 MCP 和 CLI 接入说明。
